name: elevenlabs
summary: Successfully completed the ElevenLabs quickstart end-to-end. Installed the elevenlabs SDK and python-dotenv, created the example script, and generated an audio file from text using the Text-to-Speech API. The output.mp3 file (44,765 bytes) was created and verified as a valid MPEG ADTS Layer III MP3 at 128 kbps, 44.1 kHz.
deviations: The quickstart instructs using `play(audio)` to play audio through speakers. Since the sandbox is a headless environment with no audio output capability, I deviated by saving the generated audio to a file (`output.mp3`) instead. This was necessary to verify the promised outcome (generating an audio file from text) in this environment. The core API call and text-to-speech generation followed the quickstart exactly.

env_ready.evidence: Defaulting to user installation because normal site-packages is not writeable

verified.evidence: output.mp3: Audio file with ID3 version 2.4.0, contains: MPEG ADTS, layer III, v1, 128 kbps, 44.1 kHz, Monaural
